sections.html: The bright white "shear-fingers" are very remarkable and give this species, imported from Sri Lanka, a special attraction.

Palaemon concinnus can be found over an enormous range that includes nearly the entire Indo-Pacific. Origin: coastal regions of the Indo-Pacific. The species was first designated as Macrobrachium "White Fingers".
It is a rather delicate, smaller species, so one could try to keep it together with small fish. Because it is a newly imported species, no information is available on its behaviour in the aquarium.
Because it is a newly imported species, no information is available on its breeding.
An opportunity to break new ground is offered here to the crustacean enthusiast, and surely interesting discoveries will follow.
